hypothesis: One shared covariance assumes the same within-class variability in infectious, noninfectious and normal groups. Add cautiously shrunk class-specific covariance evidence in the unchanged MLP embedding.
normalization: The covariance for classc is(1-rho)*regularized_shared +rho*((1-shrinkage)*class_covariance +(shrinkage+1e-5)*shared_variance*I). Means/covariances are equally weighted per patient within class, class priors1/3.
control: At class_covariance_weight0 exactly recovers existing coarse shared-covariance geometry and probabilities; both source MLP and existing shared branch are fixed controls.
evaluation: All4configurations receive validation and all original3outer patient folds; each covariance uses only source fitting patients. No test/query adaptation.
selection: Must exceed M5 originalCV and preserve M5 validation Macro-F1. Any later promotion requires new fixed patient confirmation against both M5 and existing development-confirmed Gaussian recipe.
external_test_policy: No external outcomes, predictions or raw images; no external scoring.
